requirements.reason: The visible Note 1 expressly states that the Company completed the xAI acquisition on February 2, 2026 and that xAI became a wholly-owned subsidiary. The same evidence identifies the Company as SpaceX.

citations.quote:
On February 2, 2026, the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp. (“xAI”), pursuant to which 
xAI became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (“xAI Merger”).

requirements.reason: The visible accounting note explicitly identifies both mergers as common-control reorganizations because Elon Musk held controlling financial interests through majority voting interests, and states that net assets are retrospectively combined at historical carrying amounts for all periods with no new goodwill or other intangible assets recorded.

citations.quote:
The Mergers have been accounted for as reorganizations of entities under common control as Mr. Elon Musk had a 
controlling financial interest in the Company, xAI and X through his majority voting interest in each such entity 
during the years presented in these consolidated financial statements. The Company’s consolidated financial 
statements have been prepared to reflect the retrospective combination of the net assets of the entities at their 
historical carrying amounts for all periods presented. No new goodwill or other intangible assets have been recorded 
and all historical related party transactions between the entities have been eliminated in consolidation.

limitations: Cross-model agent audit, not human adjudication.
